title: Related Companies to launch sales for South Flagler House in West Palm Beach | Related Ross
description: Related Companies today announced it will launch sales for South Flagler House in early November. Located along the Gold Coast in West Palm Beach, Florida, South Flagler House offers an unparalleled luxury residential experience in the Palm Beaches featuring exquisite design and spectacular waterfront views. The first luxury residential high-rise in Florida designed by world-renowned architecture firm Robert A.M.
